description: Authoritative AudioBrain operator contracts. The editor, compiler, runtime and public catalog derive from this registry; browser devices require explicit session activation.

signalTypes.description: Transport snapshot with beats, BPM, epoch and corresponding host-monotonic time; available when audio is unarmed, not an animation tick.
Bounded geometric paths with stable point/segment identities and coordinate metadata.
Bounded continuous geometric feature frame stamped in host-monotonic seconds with epoch; no musical pitch interpretation.
Bounded continuous musical voice controls with stable voice IDs.
Bounded timestamped geometric feature-event batch in host-monotonic seconds with epoch.
Bounded timestamped musical note-event batch in host-monotonic seconds with epoch.
Bounded graph topology with stable vertex/edge identities.
Host-owned runtime audio bus with explicit channel layout; not serialized sample buffers.
Finite scalar control/telemetry value with declared meaning and units.
Bounded UTF-8 text; interpreted only by the consuming node contract.

operators.title: Transport
operators.description: Host transport snapshot with beats, BPM, epoch and host-monotonic seconds. It runs without audio; the armed audio scheduler maps host time into context time.

operators.title: Shape Geometry
operators.description: Bounded closed contour generated independently from view rendering.

operators.title: Shape Reader
operators.description: Read a contour with up to twelve point, line or radar playheads. Each keeps its own phase, direction and line axis; mixed readers can share the same geometry.

operators.title: Shape to Voices
operators.description: Convert geometric measurements into stable continuous voice identities, frequency, amplitude, and pan.

operators.title: Continuous Voice Bank
operators.description: Bounded continuous voices driven by musical voice controls; one host-owned audio bus.

operators.title: L-System Grammar
operators.description: Bounded deterministic symbol expansion; grammar evaluation has no drawing or synthesis side effects.

operators.title: L-System Geometry
operators.description: Interpret symbols into bounded branch paths without assigning musical notes.

operators.title: L-System Frontier
operators.description: Advance a bounded branch frontier from transport state and emit geometric encounters stamped in host-monotonic seconds with epoch.

operators.title: Branches to Notes
operators.description: Map branch encounters to timestamped musical note events; preserve event identity and host-monotonic stamp with epoch.

operators.title: Polyphonic Voice Bank
operators.description: Bounded note-event voice bank with host-owned scheduling and release lifecycle.

operators.title: Graph Topology
operators.description: Seeded layered topology is instrument data; its internal links are not AudioBrain cable cycles.

operators.title: Graph Walk
operators.description: Traverse topology with seeded state and report timed vertex/edge encounters independently from sound.

operators.title: Graph to Notes
operators.description: Map graph encounters to timestamped note events using root frequency and angular pitch conversion; preserve the host-monotonic stamp with epoch.

operators.title: Graph Voice Bank
operators.description: Bounded event-driven graph instrument voice bank with a declared decay parameter.

operators.title: Gain
operators.description: Explicit decibel gain stage; smooth changes at the audio boundary.

operators.title: Audio Output
operators.description: Host output demand root. Saved presence does not arm audio or grant access to a device.

operators.title: Level Meter
operators.description: Read a post-gain audio bus and publish finite normalized RMS telemetry; never write samples to project state.

operators.title: Shapes View
operators.description: View-only demand root observing the contour and optional reader features; rendering never owns geometry or voices.

operators.title: Branch View
operators.description: View-only demand root observing branch geometry and optional traversal encounters.

operators.title: Graph View
operators.description: View-only demand root observing topology and optional walk encounters.

operators.title: Filter
operators.description: Native Web Audio biquad filter; connected numeric controls override saved literals.

operators.title: Delay
operators.description: Bounded internal delay feedback; ordinary graph cable cycles remain invalid.

operators.title: Stereo Pan
operators.description: Equal-power stereo placement from left (-1) to right (+1).

operators.title: Oscillator
operators.description: Continuous native oscillator; starts only after explicit audio activation.

operators.title: Value
operators.description: A finite scalar source, with a saved value retained beneath any connected modulation.

operators.title: Range Map
operators.description: Clamped linear range conversion. Equal input bounds resolve to the output minimum.

operators.title: LFO
operators.description: Host-clock sine control modulation independent of graphics and audio activation.

operators.title: Microphone
operators.description: Session-owned microphone input enabled only by an explicit device action; disconnected or unavailable input is silent.

operators.title: MIDI In
operators.description: Explicitly selected Web MIDI input; channel zero accepts all channels, selected CC normalizes to 0–1. No SysEx.

operators.title: MIDI Out
operators.description: Timestamped note output to an explicitly selected session MIDI route.

operators.title: OSC In
operators.description: Explicit session gateway required for browser OSC; one selected finite control address.

operators.title: OSC Out
operators.description: Explicit session gateway required for browser OSC; one selected finite control address.

operators.title: Brain Control In
operators.description: Versioned finite control transport; peer pairing and endpoint permissions belong to the session.

operators.title: Brain Control Out
operators.description: Versioned finite control transport; peer pairing and endpoint permissions belong to the session.
